The display pipeline is: `RuneDataSO` (data) → `RuneSlot`/`ShopPanel` build a `RuneEquipArgs` and raise it on `RuneInfoEventChannelSO` → `RuneInfoPanel` listens and writes the values into `Text` components.

## Files found & read (full contents captured)

### 1. Core UI files (the 4 requested)
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Framework/Panel/RunePanel.cs`** — `UIScreen`. Orchestrates the rune list & equipment. Builds `RuneSlot` instances from `ownedRuneIds` + `RuneDatabaseSO`. On selection (`SetRuneSlotItemSelected`) it constructs a `RuneEquipArgs(slotId, RuneName, RunePowers, SpecialPowerName, SpecialPowerDescription)` and raises it via `EventChannelLocator.MainContainer.runeInfoChannel.Raise(args)`. Handles equip/unequip/swap, drag-drop onto `RuneEquip`, reorder, equipped marks.
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/RuneInfoPanel.cs`** — `MonoBehaviour` in `UI` namespace. **The actual display panel.** Registers as listener on `runeInfoChannel` (`OnEnable`); `RuneEventTran` → `UpdateRuneInfo(runeName, runePowers, specialPowerName, specialPowerDescription)`. Binds Text fields via `transform.Find`: `RuneName`, `SpecialPower/SpecialName`, `SpecialPower/SpecialDescription`, `PowerPanel/PowerInfo_1`, `PowerPanel/PowerInfo_2`. Formats each power as `+{value}{label}` (or `-` if key≤0). Only fills PowerInfo_1/PowerInfo_2 (first two powers).
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Framework/Widget/RuneSlot.cs`** — `UIWidget`, click/drag/drop handler. Displays `iconImage` + `nameText`. `Setup(RuneDataSO)` sets icon/name. Exposes `RunePowers` (builds `Dictionary<int,string>` from `runeData.powers`, key=value, val=label), `RuneName`, `SpecialPowerName`, `SpecialPowerDescription`. Has selected/hover/equipped sprite states + drag ghost.
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Framework/Widget/RuneEquip.cs`** — `UIWidget` for the two equip slots. `Equip(runeId, icon, RuneSlot)` sets `EquippedRuneId`/`EquippedIcon`/`EquippedRuneSlot` and shows icon; `Unequip()` clears. `IDropHandler` for drag-drop, `SetHighlight` for drag target glow.

### 2. Supporting data/event files
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Rune/RuneDataSO.cs`** — ScriptableObject data source. Fields: `runeId`, `runeName`, `icon`, `iconName`, `rarity`, `powers` (`List<RunePower>`), `specialPowerName`, `specialPowerDescription` ([TextArea]), `exclusiveCharacterType`. `RunePower` struct = `{ int value; string label; }` (e.g. value=30, label="%基础伤害"). `enum Rarity { Common, Epic, Legendary, Exclusive }`.
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Core/EventSystem/RuneEquipArgs.cs`** — `EventArgsBase` carrying `slotId`, `runeName`, `runePowers` (`Dictionary<int,string>`), `specialPowerName`, `specialPowerDescription`.
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Core/EventSystem/RuneInfoEventChannelSO.cs`** — `BaseEventChannelSO<RuneEquipArgs>` (the channel both `RunePanel` and `ShopPanel` raise, and `RuneInfoPanel` listens to).

### 3. Other UI file that displays rune details
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Framework/Panel/ShopPanel.cs`** — Shop screen. `OnRuneSelected(ShopRuneConfigSO, RuneSlot)` sets `detailName.text = runeConfig.runeName`, `detailDescription.text = runeConfig.description`, `detailPrice.text`. Then (lines ~196-214) builds `runePowers` dictionary from `runeConfig.runeData.powers` and raises a `RuneEquipArgs` on `runeInfoChannel` — reusing the shared `RuneInfoPanel` to display powers/special powers, consistent with `RunePanel`.

### 4. Peripheral / non-display rune files (read for completeness)
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Rune/RuneEffectApplier.cs`** — static applier; applies `runeData.powers` (via Lua hotfix or C# switch on label: "%基础伤害"→AttackPower, "%暴击率"→CriticalChance, "%防御力"→DefensePower, "%攻击速度"→AttackInterval) and `specialPowerName` to player attributes. Outputs values via `Debug.Log` only (not UI Text).
- **`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Rune/DropItemRune.cs`** — drop item; logs `runeData.runeName` via `Debug.Log` only (not UI display).
- 4 animation files (selection/hover visuals, no text/value display): `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/Framework/Animation/RuneSelectedAnim.cs`, `RuneDeSelectedAnim.cs`, `RuneHoverEnterAnim.cs`, `RuneHoverExitAnim.cs`.

## Key data-flow for rune info display
`RuneDataSO.powers` (List of {value,label}) → `RuneSlot.RunePowers` builds `Dictionary<int,string>` (value→label) → `RunePanel`/`ShopPanel` wrap into `RuneEquipArgs` → `RuneInfoEventChannelSO.Raise` → `RuneInfoPanel.UpdateRuneInfo` writes `runeNameText`, `runePowers_1Text`/`runePowers_2Text` (as `+{value}{label}`), `specialPowerNameText`, `specialPowerDescriptionText`.

Note: `RuneInfoPanel` only renders the first **two** powers (PowerInfo_1/PowerInfo_2); if a rune has more than 2 `powers`, extras are silently dropped.
